extracted_factors.Label: IndoMet Project Coal Mining
extracted_factors.Description: BHP Billiton's IndoMet Project involves developing coal mining concessions that threaten primary rainforests, indigenous lands, and water resources.

extracted_factors.Label: Central Kalimantan Railway Development
extracted_factors.Description: Planned railway to facilitate coal extraction, potentially causing environmental damage and displacement of communities.

extracted_factors.Label: Biodiversity Threat in Heart of Borneo
extracted_factors.Description: Mining and associated developments pose a threat to the Heart of Borneo's biodiversity, impacting species like orangutans and clouded leopards.

extracted_factors.Label: Impact on Indigenous Communities
extracted_factors.Description: The IndoMet Project affects traditional lands and livelihoods of the indigenous Dayak peoples, risking cultural and sustenance loss.

extracted_factors.Label: Water Pollution and Quality Degradation
extracted_factors.Description: Mining operations could lead to erosion and pollution of water sources, impacting millions reliant on river water for daily needs.

extracted_factors.Label: Economic Development Initiatives
extracted_factors.Description: Government initiatives like MP3EI drive infrastructure development that facilitates extractive projects like IndoMet.
